name: coach-mark
title: Coach mark
description: The bubble that points at one control and says what it is for. Guidance beside the game, not a dialog in front of it: it is dismissible by keyboard, Escape closes it from wherever focus happens to be, and it never traps focus, never takes it and adds exactly one stop to the tab order. `data-gs-placement` is where it sits and `data-gs-anchor` is the id of the element it points at, and placement is CSS driven by the attribute rather than a positioning library. Dismissal is a state rather than an unmount, so `data-gs-dismissed="true"` tells a test that the player closed it. Performs nothing: it does not decide when to appear, remember that it was closed, or advance a sequence.
docs: Give it both halves of where it points: `anchor` is the id of the control the guidance is about, `placement` is where the bubble sits inside its container. It positions against the nearest positioned ancestor, so put `position: relative` on the surface the guidance belongs to. Pass `dismissed` and `onDismiss` as a controlled pair: the host owns whether it is closed and what closing remembers, and a coach mark with no `onDismiss` renders no close control and binds no Escape handler. Pass `step` and `max` for "2 of 5", and `active` for the one a sequence is on now. Render one at a time: they all answer Escape.
